title: Six reasons parents stay with us from Nursery to Class XII
description: Not slogans. These are the things parents tell us made the difference, and the things we are held to every year.

items.title: Experienced faculty
items.description: Teachers who go beyond the syllabus — who stay back for the student who has not understood, and who prepare the one who has raced ahead.

items.title: Smart classrooms
items.description: Digital teaching boards in regular use across the school, so a diagram can be drawn, animated, revisited and taken home.

items.title: Activity-based learning
items.description: Science that is done rather than described. Physics and computer laboratories, robotics workshops and exhibitions run through the year.

items.title: Value education
items.description: Ethics, empathy and environmental responsibility — plantation drives, community days and a motto that is actually used.

items.title: Career guidance
items.description: Structured counselling for senior students choosing streams, entrance routes and degree programmes — including our own BBA and BCCA.

items.title: A safe campus
items.description: Full CCTV coverage, guards at the gate and inside the premises, photo ID for every student, and attendants assigned to each section.
